title: Narrow Project Source issue to route probe and source-list consistency after live readback proof
forbiddenActions: Do not use thread file upload as fallback for Project workspace input.
Do not inline or base64-encode policy source as fallback Project input.
Do not treat upload UI visibility, temporary source text, source-list emptiness, or user-prompt marker hits as worker-readable proof.
Do not treat project-transport-env recommendedRoute=null as a hard transport blocker when a same-run Project Source upload, Project thread creation, and assistant-only delayed readback succeeded.
Do not treat project-source-list count 0 as Project Source absence when same-run worker-readable thread evidence proves the source was readable.
closeCriteria: project-transport-env either verifies the target Project route in the successful same-run case or returns a narrower advisory/probe status that cannot override successful source-put, thread-create, and delayed assistant readback evidence.

project-source-list either parses the readable Project Source/current thread source chip correctly or returns a non-authoritative status that cannot be interpreted as source absence when worker-readable evidence exists.

project-transport-run and docs combine route probe, upload, thread create, source-list, and delayed readback without downgrading a proven worker-readable route to blocked solely because env/list probes disagree.

Regression coverage includes the 2026-05-26 live pattern: source upload ok, thread create ok, delayed assistant readback ok, project-transport-env project-route-not-verified, and project-source-list source-list-empty.
Docs state that delayed assistant-only readback is the worker-readable proof; env and source-list are route/inventory probes with explicit false-negative boundaries.
requiredEvidence: Nix build or check for ops-cdp-core passes after the consistency fix.
Regression or replay evidence covers env false negative and source-list empty while delayed assistant readback succeeds.
Docs explain the authority order among Project Source upload visibility, route probe, source-list inventory, and delayed assistant readback.

title: Avoid substring false objections for NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS marker responses
forbiddenActions: Do not classify NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS as UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS because of substring matching.
Do not use marker fallback as a semantic pass/fail authority when structured verdict fields are available.
Do not close this issue without a regression test covering assistantText-only NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS responses from all required actors.
closeCriteria: facilitate-discussion classifies same-revision assistantText NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS responses from all required actors as facilitation-no-objections-confirmed.
Marker fallback uses exact marker, line-level, token-boundary, or precedence-safe matching so accepted markers containing rejected marker text are not misclassified.
Regression tests cover two assistantText-only NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS responses, mixed structured verdict plus assistantText, and real UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS responses.
Existing ops-thread-fsm tests pass through the Nix/package check route.
requiredEvidence: Nix build or check for ops-thread-fsm passes after the fix.
A regression test fails on current main and passes after the fix for NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS assistantText-only responses.
Evidence records the current repro and the fixed output.
evidence: /home/nixos/repos/ops/issues/evidence/ops-thread-fsm-marker-substring-20260526/repro.json records current main behavior: two NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS assistantText responses classify as facilitation-revision-update-required with objection marker matched.
